newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner to create global funds division.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner to create global funds division.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG said on Friday it planned to merge its global funds business, comprising RCM Capital Management, Kleinwort Benson International Management and Thornton & Co into a global funds organisation led by RCM.
In a statement, Dresdner said the newly created organisation would manage assets of more than $50 billion worldwide outside of Germany.

The merger of the divisions, which concerns only their institutional funds business, would accelerate Dresdner's drive to become a global funds management operator with a strong presence in the U.S., Europe and Asia, Dresdner said.
Together, the units would offer a broader range of investment options and research expertise and would work together to develop a comprehensive global analysis network.
Dresdner management board member Gerhard Eberstadt said in the statement: "The three organisations joining together complement each other wonderfully."

"The integration of their business will create major advantages for our customers worldwide, in that it brings together a wide and improved range of global investment products and services," Eberstadt added.
A team of specialists from the three divisions was already working on integrating their operations, Dresdner said, adding that the units already co-operated extensively with one another.
Together, the three units have 900 staff based in financial centres in the U.S., Europe and Asia.
